                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                                 (
                                     SELECT 1
                                     FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                     WHERE
                                       parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
									   and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                                 )
                     )
             GROUP BY
                 parent.party_name,
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
                 COALESCE(country.name, parent.domicile_country_code),
                 parent.rtg_final,
                 parent.rtg_outlook
         ),
     prev_exp_total AS
         (
             SELECT
                 parent.party_name,
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 parent.rtg_final AS prev_rtg_final,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_total_cash_pb_exp,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_isrc_total_exp,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_smd_total_exp
             FROM
                     prev_business_date prev
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
                                ON prev.business_date = child.business_date
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact
                                ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
                                ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
                                ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id 
                                    AND UPPER(pos.PRODUCT_TYPE) <> 'NETTING'
             WHERE
                 parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                 OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                 OR EXISTS
                 (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                     WHERE
                       parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
					   and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                 )
             GROUP BY
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 parent.party_name,
                 parent.rtg_final
         ),
     child_level_exp_limits AS
         (
             SELECT
                 parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
                 child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_cash_pb_exp,
                 MAX(child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.repo_fi_limit) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS der_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_fi_limit) AS der_smd_threshold,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_repo_fi_limit) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                          OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS smd_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.smd_total_fi_limit) AS smd_total_limit
             FROM
                 radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
                 radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date = '2025-06-04' 
				 and fact.business_date = child.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                             (
                                 SELECT 1
                                 FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                 WHERE
                                     parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
									 and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                     AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                     AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                             )
                  )
             GROUP BY
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 child.cppib_party_id
         ),
     breaches_under_parents AS
         (
             SELECT
                 cppib_party_id,
                 MIN(status) AS status
             FROM
                 (
                     SELECT
                         cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
                         CASE
                             WHEN total_cash_pb_exp >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit OR total_der_repo_sbl_exp >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit OR isrc_total_exp >= isrc_total_limit OR smd_total_exp >= smd_total_limit THEN 'BREACH'
                             WHEN der_exp >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exp >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
                             ELSE 'OK'
                             END AS status
                     FROM child_level_exp_limits
                 ) p
             GROUP BY cppib_party_id
         )
SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,
    SUM(pb_exp) / 1000000 AS pb_exp,
    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,

    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,
    COALESCE(isrc_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS isrc_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 10000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,
    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown
FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'parent' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    der_smd_threshold,
    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    c.party_name,
    country_code,
    rtg_final,
    rtg_outlook,
    isrc_total_limit,
    smd_total_limit,
    b.status
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
        WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, ultimate_parent_party_name || ' | ' || issuer_name || ' | ' || security_name as combined_entity_name_original
		, ultimate_parent_party_name || ' | ' || issuer_name || ' | ' || security_name_clean as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaption|option|future|contract|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "entity_search_holdings_lookthrough"

FROM (with lt_base as (

		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,

	from (

		from

				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'

				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'

			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date

	on

	on

	left join

			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'

        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,

-- Query # 7 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i

-- Query # 7 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i

-- Query # 7 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

SELECT "party_name", "cppib_party_id", "cppib_party_id_str", "parent_cppib_party_id", "ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id", "bloomberg_company_id", "incorp_country_code", "legal_entity_name", "cppib_country_of_exposure_code", "cppib_sector_classification_name_1", "cppib_sector_classification_name_2", "cppib_sector_classification_name_3", "cppib_sector_classification_name_4", "has_securities_flag", "has_children", "has_parent", "party_name_word1", "party_name_word2", "party_name_word3", "party_name_word4", "party_name_word5", "party_name_word6", "party_name_word7", "party_name_word8", "party_name_word9", "party_name_word10", "party_name_word11", "party_name_word12", "party_name_word13", "party_name_word14", "party_name_word15"
FROM (SELECT
    COALESCE(eu."party_name", '') AS "party_name",
    eu."cppib_party_id" AS "cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "cppib_party_id_str",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."parent_cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "parent_cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(CAST(eu."ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id",
    COALESCE(eu."bloomberg_company_id", '') AS "bloomberg_company_id",
    COALESCE(eu."incorp_country_code", '') AS "incorp_country_code",
    COALESCE(eu."legal_entity_name", '') AS "legal_entity_name",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_country_of_exposure_code", '') AS "cppib_country_of_exposure_code",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_1", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_1",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_2", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_2",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_3", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_3",
    COALESCE(eu."cppib_sector_classification_name_4", '') AS "cppib_sector_classification_name_4",
    CASE
        WHEN eu."has_securities" = 1 THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS "has_securities_flag",
    COALESCE(child_flags.has_children, 'NO') AS has_children,
    CASE
        WHEN eu."parent_cppib_party_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS has_parent,

    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 1))  AS party_name_word1,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 2))  AS party_name_word2,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 3))  AS party_name_word3,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 4))  AS party_name_word4,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 5))  AS party_name_word5,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 6))  AS party_name_word6,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 7))  AS party_name_word7,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 8))  AS party_name_word8,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 9))  AS party_name_word9,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 10)) AS party_name_word10,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 11)) AS party_name_word11,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 12)) AS party_name_word12,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 13)) AS party_name_word13,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 14)) AS party_name_word14,
    LOWER(split_part(eu.party_name, ' ', 15)) AS party_name_word15

FROM legal_dc_prod.entities_universe eu

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        parent_cppib_party_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'YES'
            ELSE 'NO'
        END AS has_children
    FROM legal_dc_prod.entities_universe
    GROUP BY parent_cppib_party_id
) AS child_flags
ON eu.cppib_party_id = child_flags.parent_cppib_party_id
) AS "entities_universe"

-- Query # 25 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 25 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date

-- Query # 25 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined'

-- Query # 25 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 05
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-05 20:20:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				or (

			)

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	/* DATA PULLED:

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

		from

			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

				(

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

			 */
			union all

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly

				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'

			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id

			and scd.split_level = perf."level"

			and (

				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )

				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

/* cppi::53e918e3e5b080e4928cbb74fb4d5839e8b182ec1e327034919131d27d790763 */
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (
                        SELECT DISTINCT
                            si.cppib_sec_id AS ID_CPPIBSEC,
                            date_format(si.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DT,
                            si.cusip AS ID_CUSIP,
                            si.isin AS ID_ISIN,
                            si.sedol AS ID_SEDOL,
                            CASE si.market_sector_desc
                                WHEN 'Pfd' THEN CONCAT(si.ticker, ' Pfd')
                                WHEN 'Equity' THEN CONCAT(eu.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange, ' Equity')
                                ELSE si.ticker
                            END AS ID_TICKER,
                            si.sec_desc AS DESCRIPTION,
                            si.sec_nm AS DESCRIPTION1,

                            si.sec_shrtdesc AS DESCRIPTION3,

                            si.incorp_country_code AS INCORP_CNTRY,
                            si.issue_country AS ISSUE_CNTRY,
                            si.cntry AS CNTRY,
                            si.crncy AS CRNCY,
                            CASE si.sec_typ_lvl1_nm
                                WHEN 'Bond' THEN bo.listing_country_code
                                ELSE eu.listing_country_code
                            END AS EXCH_CNTRY
                        FROM
                            asset.asset_security_identifiers_universe si
                        LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity_universe eu ON
                            si.cppib_sec_id = eu.cppib_sec_id
                        LEFT JOIN asset.asset_bond_universe bo ON
                            si.cppib_sec_id = bo.cppib_sec_id

                            si.market_sector_desc IN ('Equity', 'Pfd')

                                AND si2.market_sector_desc IN ('Equity', 'Pfd')

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic

    FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes
    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,

group by scd_transaction_account_key),

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic
            ORDER BY CPPIB_EXCHANGE_ID ASC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes
    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

  where row_numb = 1
)

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC

    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions

  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),

  where row_numb = 1

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC

    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions

  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic
            ORDER BY CPPIB_EXCHANGE_ID ASC

    FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes
    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-24')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-24')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

		from

		where

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
